report:
Title: Discount code SAVE10 is ignored at checkout

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open the cart page
2. Enter SAVE10 in the discount field
3. Click Apply
Expected result: Total becomes 45.00 EUR
Actual result: Total stays 50.00 EUR, no error is shown
Environment: Staging, build 3.2.0, Firefox 128 on macOS 14
Severity: Major
Evidence: screenshot discount.png attached
